analysis_title: The changing geography of Philadelphia shooting violence: Project 1
outcome_definition: Shooting-victim events; fatal and nonfatal outcomes retained separately
officer_involved_exclusion: Records coded Y for officer_involved are excluded; unknown status is excluded and reported
geographic_vintage: 2020 Census tracts; 2020 Census block groups used only for sensitivity
acs_vintage_and_variable: 2020-2024 ACS 5-year B01003_001 total population estimate and margin of error
rate_definition: period_count / (fixed total population * years in period) * 10000; area-level place-based burden, not resident incidence
primary_method: Fixed 2015-2019 upper-quartile tract annualized burden benchmark
threshold_inclusion: greater than or equal to unrounded cutoff; zero-event positive-population tracts included
threshold_comparison_periods: same cutoff for 2020-2022 and 2023-2025; not recalculated within each period
supplementary_gistar_implementation: spdep 1.4.2 localG_perm; conditional greater alternative; focal unit fixed; one-sided high-tail probability derived from the reported folded permutation probability and standardized-deviate sign
supplementary_spatial_weights: first-order queen contiguity, binary, focal geography explicitly included
supplementary_threshold_revision: Exploratory post-map-review relaxation from BH q < 0.05 to q < 0.10; original threshold retained in comparison table
supplementary_fdr_method_and_threshold: Benjamini-Hochberg within period; q < 0.10 plus positive Gi* standardized deviate

transition_definitions.persistent: Persistently elevated: at or above the fixed benchmark in both periods
transition_definitions.previously: Previously elevated: at or above the benchmark only in 2020-2022
transition_definitions.newly: Newly elevated: at or above the benchmark only in 2023-2025
transition_definitions.below: Consistently below: below the benchmark in both periods
transition_definitions.unavailable: classification cannot be calculated because of denominator or geometry problems

planned_social_measures: ACS economic, housing, education, age, and racial/ethnic composition
CDC/ATSDR SVI overall and theme-specific measures, with explicit vintage and ranking reference
known_limitations: 75th percentile is a descriptive baseline reference, not a clinical or significance threshold
classification ignores uncertainty around rates and ACS population; low-count and denominator flags retained
descriptive spatial epidemiology; no causal or predictive interpretation
event location may differ from victim residence
a fixed ACS denominator does not capture all population change during 2015-2025
local statistics depend on geography, spatial weights, sparse counts, and multiple-testing decisions
below benchmark is not evidence that shooting violence is absent
source completeness checks cannot detect every reporting delay or omission
